questions.q:
Consider the following about Indus Valley:
a. Harappa was excavated by Daya Ram Sahni.
b. Mohenjodaro is located in Larkana district.
c. Lothal was a dockyard city.
d. Kalibangan is in Rajasthan.
Which of the above are correct?
questions.exp: All four statements are historically authentic and accurate.

questions.q:
Following are mountain ranges of India:
1. Garo Hills
2. Nandadevi
3. Kamet
4. K2
Which is the correct sequence from North to South?
questions.exp: K2 lies highest north in Karakoram, followed by Kamet and Nandadevi in Uttarakhand, and Garo Hills in Meghalaya.

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II:
List-I:
a. Indus Valley
b. Vedic Period
List-II:
1. Harappa
2. Rigveda
Choose the correct code:
questions.exp: Harappa belongs to Indus Valley Civilization and Rigveda belongs to Early Vedic Period.
